No text, no letters, no logos, no UI, no people. Beautiful natural woodland rather than a cartoon interface. Calm tactile nature painting, refined restrained detail. Portrait composition. A quiet woodland clearing with delicate ferns, grassy edges, leafy branches framing both sides, soft distant trees. Deep calm forest-green open centre, detail concentrated along edges and bottom. Very little bright contrast in the central 70 percent, so app content can be layered on top. Portrait 2:3.
